questions.explanation: The long background action uses the past continuous; the short one uses past simple.
questions.q: I ___ dinner when he arrived.

questions.explanation: The short, sudden action uses the past simple.
questions.q: She ___ her leg while she was playing tennis.

questions.explanation: The action in progress uses the past continuous.
questions.q: While they ___, it started to rain.

questions.explanation: Finished actions in sequence use the past simple.
questions.q: He ___ TV and then went to bed.

questions.explanation: The short completed action uses the past simple: 'woke'.
questions.q: When I ___, the sun was shining.

questions.explanation: The interrupting short action uses the past simple.
questions.q: While I was cooking, the phone ___.

questions.explanation: An action in progress at a specific past time uses the past continuous.
questions.q: She ___ a book at 9 pm last night.

questions.explanation: A finished action in the past uses the past simple.
questions.q: We ___ our homework before dinner yesterday.

questions.explanation: A finished past action uses the past simple: 'saw'.
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?

questions.explanation: The action in progress when interrupted uses the past continuous.
questions.q: The kids ___ when the teacher came in.

questions.explanation: The short sudden action uses the past simple.
questions.q: He ___ his keys while he was running.

questions.explanation: The background action in progress uses the past continuous.
questions.q: I ___ to school when I saw the accident.

questions.explanation: A finished past period uses the past simple.
questions.q: She ___ in London in 2020.

questions.explanation: The action in progress uses the past continuous.
questions.q: While we ___, someone knocked.

questions.explanation: After 'were' we need verb-ing: 'were playing'.
options: They were play football at 5 pm.
questions.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

questions.explanation: Weather in progress at a past moment uses the past continuous.
questions.q: It ___ hard when we left.

questions.explanation: A single finished action uses the past simple.
questions.q: I ___ my wallet yesterday.

questions.explanation: The action in progress when interrupted uses the past continuous.
questions.q: They ___ TV when the lights went out.

questions.explanation: A sudden completed action uses the past simple.
questions.q: She ___ and broke her arm.

questions.explanation: The action in progress when interrupted uses the past continuous.
questions.q: We ___ chess when Mom called us for dinner.
